collabpatrol-desc: Short description of the extension shown on Special:Version.
right-collabpatrol-use: Permission label shown in user rights pages.
rightdesc-collabpatrol-use: Description of the permission to use collaborative patrol actions.
right-collabpatrol-admin: Permission label shown in user rights pages.
rightdesc-collabpatrol-admin: Description of the permission to administer collaborative patrol.
right-collabpatrol-chatmod: Permission label shown in user rights pages.
rightdesc-collabpatrol-chatmod: Description of the permission to moderate collaborative patrol chat.
collabpatrol-dashboard-title: Title of the Special:CollabPatrol dashboard page.
collabpatrol-status-in-progress: Label for the 'in progress' patrol status.
collabpatrol-btn-flag: Button label to flag a revision for collaborative review.
collabpatrol-btn-take: Button label to take ownership of a pending revision.
collabpatrol-btn-finish: Button label to mark a revision as finished.
collabpatrol-btn-cancel: Button label to cancel / remove a patrol entry.
collabpatrol-btn-ban: Button label to open the block-user page.
collabpatrol-comment-placeholder: Placeholder text in the comment input field.
collabpatrol-history-label: Header label above the history block.
collabpatrol-counter-pending: RC counter label. $1 = number of pending entries.
collabpatrol-counter-progress: RC counter label. $1 = number of in-progress entries.
collabpatrol-notify-patrolled: Notification shown after a revision is auto-patrolled.
collabpatrol-notify-error: Notification shown when an API call fails.
collabpatrol-confirm-remove: Confirmation prompt before removing a patrol entry.
collabpatrol-confirm-ban: Prefix of the confirmation prompt before opening the block page. The username is appended after.
collabpatrol-time-now: Elapsed time label when less than 1 minute ago.
collabpatrol-time-minutes: Elapsed time label. $1 = number of minutes.
collabpatrol-time-hours: Elapsed time label. $1 = number of hours.
collabpatrol-time-days: Elapsed time label. $1 = number of days.
collabpatrol-dashboard-filter-all: Dashboard dropdown option to show all statuses.
collabpatrol-dashboard-filter-pending: Dashboard dropdown option to filter pending entries.
collabpatrol-dashboard-filter-progress: Dashboard dropdown option to filter in-progress entries.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-id: Dashboard table column header for the revision ID.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-status: Dashboard table column header for the status.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-user: Dashboard table column header for the user who flagged the revision.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-comment: Dashboard table column header for the comment/note.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-age: Dashboard table column header for elapsed time.
collabpatrol-dashboard-col-actions: Dashboard table column header for action buttons.
collabpatrol-stats-total: Stats table row label for total historical actions.
collabpatrol-stats-pending: Stats table row label for current pending count.
collabpatrol-stats-progress: Stats table row label for current in-progress count.
collabpatrol-stats-finished: Stats table row label for current finished count.
collabpatrol-stats-top-patrollers: Heading above the top patrollers list.
collabpatrol-chat-title: Title/header of the per-diff discussion chat panel. Shown collapsed on diff pages when an entry is active.
collabpatrol-chat-placeholder: Placeholder text in the chat message input. Should mention the keyboard shortcut to send.
collabpatrol-chat-mention-hint: Hint shown in chat input to explain mention syntax using @username.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-send: Button label to send a chat message.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-delete: Tooltip on the delete button shown on each chat message (for moderators).
collabpatrol-chat-btn-delete-label: Visible label on the chat moderation button that deletes a message.
collabpatrol-chat-deleted: Tombstone text shown instead of a soft-deleted message. Moderators also see the name of who deleted it appended in parentheses.
collabpatrol-chat-empty: Placeholder shown when a chat has no messages yet.
collabpatrol-chat-too-long: Error shown when the user tries to send a message that exceeds CollabPatrolChatMaxLength characters.
collabpatrol-chat-banned-word: Error shown when the message is rejected because it contains a word from CollabPatrolChatBannedWords.
collabpatrol-chat-send-error: Generic error shown when the API call to send a chat message fails.
collabpatrol-chat-user-banned: Error shown when the current user is banned from CollabPatrol chat.
collabpatrol-chat-confirm-delete: Confirmation prompt shown before a moderator deletes a chat message.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-ban: Tooltip on the action button for banning a user from CollabPatrol chat.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-ban-label: Visible label on the chat moderation button that bans a user from chat.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-unban: Tooltip on the action button for removing a CollabPatrol chat ban.
collabpatrol-chat-btn-unban-label: Visible label on the chat moderation button that removes a chat ban.
collabpatrol-chat-confirm-ban: Confirmation prompt before banning a user from CollabPatrol chat. $1 is the username.
collabpatrol-chat-confirm-unban: Confirmation prompt before removing a CollabPatrol chat ban. $1 is the username.
collabpatrol-chat-ban-success: Notification shown after a successful chat ban. $1 is the username.
collabpatrol-chat-unban-success: Notification shown after a successful chat unban. $1 is the username.
collabpatrol-chat-toggle-open: Label on the button that opens (expands) the chat panel.
collabpatrol-chat-toggle-close: Label on the button that closes (collapses) the chat panel.
collabpatrol-chat-count: Badge showing how many visible (non-deleted) messages are in the discussion. $1 = number of messages.
collabpatrol-user-dashboard-title: Title of Special:CollabUserDashboard, the personal dashboard page for each patroller.
collabpatrol-user-dashboard-promo: Promo text displayed on dashboard and active diff pages to point users to the personal dashboard.
collabpatrol-userdash-section-mentions: Section title for active chat mentions in the personal dashboard.
collabpatrol-userdash-section-inprogress: Section title for revisions currently in progress by the current user.
collabpatrol-userdash-section-suggested: Section title for pending revisions suggested to the current user.
collabpatrol-userdash-empty-mentions: Empty-state message when the personal dashboard has no active mentions.
collabpatrol-userdash-empty-inprogress: Empty-state message when the personal dashboard has no in-progress revisions.
collabpatrol-userdash-empty-suggested: Empty-state message when there are no suggested pending revisions to take.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-revision: Table column header for revision IDs on personal dashboard tables.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-status: Table column header for entry status on personal dashboard tables.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-from: Table column header for the user who mentioned or created the item.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-message: Table column header for associated chat message or comment on personal dashboard tables.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-age: Table column header for elapsed time on personal dashboard tables.
collabpatrol-userdash-col-actions: Table column header for action buttons on personal dashboard tables.
collabpatrol-userdash-open-diff: Action label that opens the related diff page.
collabpatrol-userdash-take: Action button label to take a pending revision from the personal dashboard.
collabpatrol-userdash-finish: Action button label to finish an in-progress revision from the personal dashboard.
collabpatrol-userdash-helptext: Short helper text at the top of the personal dashboard describing its purpose.
echo-category-title-collabpatrol-chat-me: Echo preference category label for CollabPatrol chat mention notifications.
echo-pref-tooltip-collabpatrol-chat-ment: Echo preference category tooltip for CollabPatrol chat mention notifications.
notification-collabpatrol-chat-mention: Echo notification header for chat mentions. $1 is the user who mentioned, $2 is the page title.
notification-body-collabpatrol-chat-ment: Echo notification body for chat mentions. $1 is a short excerpt of the message.
notification-link-text-collabpatrol-chat: Primary link label shown in the Echo notification for a chat mention.
prefs-collabpatrol: Section header on Special:Preferences for CollabPatrol options.
collabpatrol-pref-refresh-interval: Label for the user preference controlling auto-refresh frequency.
collabpatrol-pref-refresh-manual: Option label for disabling auto-refresh and using manual refresh only.
collabpatrol-pref-notify-finished: Toggle label for showing a notification when an entry is marked finished.
collabpatrol-pref-chat-open-default: Toggle label for opening the discussion panel by default on active entries.
collabpatrol-pref-show-history: Toggle label for showing the history block under an entry.
collabpatrol-pref-compact-mode: Toggle label for using a compact controls layout.
